verdict.rationale: LightSprint's docs say you can describe a change in plain English and have it built and prepared for review (docs-1). For larger features, a planning step produces options and mockups that are handed off as a single implementation task (docs-6), and tasks can be created from Slack, Linear or Jira requests (docs-26). missing for 10: detail on how plain-language input is automatically scoped or broken into a task (planning appears team-guided rather than automatic), explicit evidence for bug reports flowing through the same intent-to-task path, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing.
